newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek yield curve idles in listless thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Greek yield curve idles in listless thin trade.

text.p: Greek money rates were trading narrowly in late trade holding morning levels but for one week funds that eased 30 basis points, dealers said.
Bonds and foreign exchange markets were also calm with prices little changed on thin trading volumes.

"Money rates and forex forwards are steading in late, lacklustre dealing," said a foreign bank trader. "One week funds have retreated 30 basis points after a large commercial bank pumped cash into the market."
The Bank of Greece injected overnight money at 13.40 percent.
The mark was quoted at 157.52/62 drachmas from Thursday's 157.400 fix, the dollar at 244.86/96 drachmas from 245.380 and the Ecu at 303.59/69 from 303.750 drachmas.
